SCM_PO_FULFILL.name: Purchase order
SCM_PO_FULFILL.description: Happy path: create PO → send → confirm receipt → payable → payment → vendor paid. Implemented on the SCM desk.

SCM_MAKE_TO_STOCK.name: Make to stock
SCM_MAKE_TO_STOCK.description: Release → start → complete (OPEN lot) → quality check → PASS posts stock. Shop floor.

scm.prod.release.name: Release production order
scm.prod.release.tipWhat: Release a draft production order so the floor can start it.
scm.prod.release.tipPitfall: Completing without release skips the planned sequence but is still allowed from DRAFT.

scm.prod.start.name: Start production
scm.prod.start.tipWhat: Mark the order in progress on the floor.
scm.prod.start.tipPitfall: Starting a cancelled order is blocked.

scm.prod.complete.name: Complete production (create lot)
scm.prod.complete.tipWhat: Finish the make order. For goods this creates an OPEN lot — stock is not posted yet.
scm.prod.complete.tipPitfall: Expecting on-hand to rise at complete — it rises only after QA PASS.

scm.qa.check.name: Quality check (PASS / FAIL / HOLD)
scm.qa.check.tipWhat: Inspect the lot. PASS releases quantity into stock; FAIL rejects; HOLD quarantines.
scm.qa.check.tipPitfall: Skipping QA leaves finished goods invisible in on-hand.

scm.inv.available.name: Stock available (on hand)
scm.inv.available.tipWhat: After PASS, a PRODUCTION stock move posts and on-hand increases.
scm.inv.available.tipPitfall: Manual lots for stock already on hand do not post a second receipt on PASS.

SALES_QUOTE_TO_ORDER.name: Quote to sales order
SALES_QUOTE_TO_ORDER.description: Create quote → send → accept → confirm sales order (optional draft invoice). Sales desk.

sales.quote.create.name: Create customer quote
sales.quote.create.tipWhat: Start a quote for a customer with lines and amounts.
sales.quote.create.tipPitfall: Missing customer or empty lines block sending.

sales.quote.send.name: Send quote
sales.quote.send.tipWhat: Mark the quote sent so the customer can respond.
sales.quote.send.tipPitfall: Editing after send can confuse acceptance state.

sales.quote.accept.name: Accept quote
sales.quote.accept.tipWhat: Record customer acceptance of the quote.

sales.order.confirm.name: Confirm sales order
sales.order.confirm.tipWhat: Confirm the sales order from the accepted quote.
sales.order.confirm.tipPitfall: Confirming before acceptance skips the commercial handshake.

sales.order.invoice.name: Optional draft invoice
sales.order.invoice.tipWhat: Optionally open a draft invoice for Finance to issue.
sales.order.invoice.tipPitfall: Draft is not payment — still issue and settle in Finance.

FIN_INVOICE_SETTLE.name: Customer invoice settle
FIN_INVOICE_SETTLE.description: Create invoice → issue → settle via payment rails. Finance revenue desk.

fin.inv.create.name: Create invoice (draft)
fin.inv.create.tipWhat: Create a draft invoice for the customer amount.
fin.inv.create.tipPitfall: Settling a draft before issue leaves rails inconsistent.

fin.inv.issue.name: Issue invoice
fin.inv.issue.tipWhat: Issue the draft so the customer can pay (rails / PDF).
fin.inv.issue.tipPitfall: Issuing without checking amount or customer name.

fin.inv.settle.name: Settle / record payment
fin.inv.settle.tipWhat: Record payment (fiat settle, wallet address, or live BTCPay on LIVE company).
fin.inv.settle.tipPitfall: DEMO companies force mock settle; live BTCPay is LIVE-only.

DEL_SERVICE_ORDER.name: Service order fulfillment
DEL_SERVICE_ORDER.description: Create service order → schedule/assign → start → complete. Delivery desk.

AS_INQUIRY.name: Customer inquiry
AS_INQUIRY.description: Create inquiry → start work → resolve → close. After-sales desk.

HR_CANDIDATE_HIRE.name: Hire candidate
HR_CANDIDATE_HIRE.description: Create candidate → advance stages → hire → HR file. HR desk.

CAP_PROJECT.name: Project lifecycle
CAP_PROJECT.description: Create project → start → complete or cancel. Capability hub.

AR_HITL_APPROVAL.name: HITL approval
AR_HITL_APPROVAL.description: Submit agent proposal → human approve or reject. Agents hub.

FIN_LEDGER.name: Chart of accounts & ledger
FIN_LEDGER.description: Seed chart of accounts → post journal entries → trial balance → reverse / soft-close. Finance transactions desk.

AS_RMA.name: Return merchandise (RMA)
AS_RMA.description: Request RMA → confirm (stock receipt) → close. After-sales desk.

DIG_IT_TICKET.name: IT support ticket
DIG_IT_TICKET.description: Open ticket → start work → resolve → close. Digital desk.

DIG_IT_CHANGE.name: IT change
DIG_IT_CHANGE.description: Plan change → start → complete (or cancel). Digital desk — tech change, not org change.
